notes.title: We released an update including new songs!
notes.content:
· We added the song "Melty Land Nightmare" of "Harumaki Gohan".
· We changed trajectory effect in slash mode.
・The procedure for unlocking music has been simplified.
It is before a change: Unlock if you achieve any of rank A - S 5 times.
After a change: Unlock if you achieve any of ranks B - S twice..
・For the Vive version, because the controller is heavy, We improved punch power.
・In addition, We performed bug Fix.

Thank you for playng.

notes.title: Updates including Slash Mode were released!
notes.content:
Patch note
· The function to change the viewpoint displayed on the external display has been added.
  It is possible to switch between the wide-angle subjective viewpoint and the conventional third-person viewpoint.
  In case of Rift:Switch with A button on OculusTouch.
  In case of Vive:Switch with touchpad on left hand Vive controller.

· We greatly improved the music-related system, and stabilized the operation and reduced sound misalignment.

· Added music "Karisomeno Crystalize".

We implemented the "Slash Mode". In this mode, you can swing the microphone stand and switch the lyrics and stars off and play music and you can select from the options screen.Please make sure to ensure safety before you hit the surroundings, please enjoy.
In addition, you can play only two songs in Slash mode, please note that songs are not unlocked by rank. In the future, we will add music that can be played sequentially.If you have comments, opinions, etc. about this mode, please come to the thread by all means.

The contents currently under construction are as follows. Sorry for being late.
Please wait for a while.
・I display high score, a high rank, information of the full combo achievement according to music with a music choice screen.
・Indication of the liberation condition of the music.
・Threshold adjustment such as Super.
・One piece of new song addition (the best degree of difficulty)

notes.title: We will release "Slash Mode" in this weekl!
notes.content:
We are planning to release the slash mode in the first half of this week.
But first of all please only support 2 songs.This mode is different from punch mode because it is necessary to review all music notation.For that reason, we would like to receive feedback only with 2 songs first.

We are a very small team with a team consisting of three people.
It may take time, but I'd like to create a game where everyone will go.

Thanks to everyone, this game is supported. Thank you so much.
